description.en:
The status of the chart repositories that you want to query. Valid values:

*   `ALL`: query repositories of all status.
*   `NORMAL`: query normal repositories.
*   `DELETING`: query repositories that are being deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr list-chart-repository --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --repo-status NORMAL --repo-name ns1 --repo-namespace-name repo1 --page-no 1 --page-size 30 --region cn-hangzhou
